declaredIdentity: Tenant / audit-outcomes / outcomeId; program checked; same normalized content plus canonical recorder no-ops despite later server time; one creation append. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
invariant: One auditor-supplied report conclusion is immutable for its outcome identity and exact delivered package/snapshot provenance.
boundaryRationale: Nothing within the single accepted record can be independently mutated; the report artifact already has its own lifecycle.
identityReadingRule: selectedIdentitySummary and exact selectedCommandContracts define intended identity. baselineIdentityObservation/declaredIdentity retain older source observations only, including old replay defects; they are not target behavior or authorization to change an occupied key.

logicalIdentity.rule: caller-supplied immutable creation identity: an exact retry with the same id and authored intent returns the original result; the same id with changed intent is refused; a different id is a different record

baselineIdentityObservation: Tenant / audit-outcomes / outcomeId; program checked; same normalized content plus canonical recorder no-ops despite later server time; one creation append. Portia appends against the hydrated physical stream position; a logical revision does not create another physical boundary.
identityContractRule: Existing published owner identity/IdFor remains stable. Required typed creation/operation identity and tenant/program/source scope come from the selected signature/protocol references; no context.RequestId minting fallback or guessed new stream key.
selectedIdentityClarification: Tenant / audit-outcomes / OutcomeId, with immutable ProgramId, delivered package and snapshot provenance. OutcomeId is the selected immutable creation identity.
selectedIdentitySummary: Tenant / audit-outcomes / OutcomeId, with immutable ProgramId, delivered package and snapshot provenance. OutcomeId is the selected immutable creation identity.
selectedReplayRule: Current required authorization precedes replay; exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result using the selected logical identity and immutable actor/intent/source binding. Fresh mutable feasibility, clock selection and body preparation cannot replace that original result. Expected revision is concurrency precondition, not a new identity.

productRules.rule: The platform holds no attest workpaper, test conclusion, or report draft; it may retain only an issued report and the auditor-authored outcome as received, and never authors or recalculates the auditor's opinion.
Management's evaluations and sign-offs remain separate from the auditor-authored outcome received.

decides: Only an issued report and the auditor-authored outcome exactly as received are retained; the platform stores no attest workpaper, test conclusion or report draft and never authors, edits or recalculates the auditor's opinion. Management evaluations and sign-offs stay separate records and are never merged into the outcome.
